description: This PHP source file defines the RequestResetPasswordController class, responsible for handling password reset requests in the OrangeHRM authentication module. It processes HTTP requests, validates CSRF tokens, searches for user records, and redirects based on success or failure.

classes.name: RequestResetPasswordController
classes.description: Controller class handling password reset requests, extending AbstractController and implementing PublicControllerInterface.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ResetPasswordService used for processing password resets.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process the reset password request; validates CSRF token, searches for user, logs the request, and redirects accordingly.
